summary.en: Pair present forms of aller with any verb to talk about immediate plans.

body.en:
From season 1, episodes 1 and 3.

At the archway Henri offers *Je vais monter la valise*, Claire reassures Odette *on va regarder*, and during the heating scare she promises Henri *va vérifier la cave*. In each sentence a present form of *aller* (*vais*, *va*) teams up with an infinitive (*monter*, *regarder*, *vérifier*) to express 'going to do'.

Only the short helper changes with the speaker; the action verb stays in its full dictionary infinitive.

Remember that *aller* still keeps its everyday meanings too ('to go' somewhere, or *tout va bien?* 'is everything alright?'). It signals the near future specifically when another verb in the infinitive follows.

On replay, listen past *vais* or *va* to catch the infinitive carrying the real action.
